title: Greeting
description: This program reads a name from standard input and prints a greeting: Ada becomes Hello, Ada!
Whoever wrote it assumed nobody has a name longer than 255 characters. Someone will try anyway.
Fix it so any input is handled safely. A name longer than 255 characters should be cut down to its first 255 characters. Everything that works now has to keep working.
hints: Look at how many characters read_line writes into buf, and how big buf is.
read_line has no idea how big the buffer is. It needs to be told.
Don't forget the '\0' at the end. A 255-character name needs 256 bytes.
